section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive and correlation analyses results showing that early memories of warmth and safeness were positively associated with self-compassion and body appreciation, while negatively correlated with eating disorder symptoms (EDE-Q). BMI showed negative associations with body appreciation and early memories of warmth/safeness, and positive associations with EDE-Q. Age was positively correlated with BMI and self-compassion but negatively with early memories of warmth and safeness.
